name: 96 - API - Operational Dashboard Summary - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF($1::TEXT, '') AS clinic_name,
        $2::INTEGER AS period_hours,
        $3::INTEGER AS detail_limit
),

scope AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,
        clinic.id AS clinic_id
    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
),

message_statuses AS (
    SELECT
        message.status,
        COUNT(*) AS status_count
    FROM outbound_messages message
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE message.created_at >=
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              hours => scope_row.period_hours
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR message.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY message.status
),

delivery_events AS (
    SELECT
        delivery.event_type,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM communication_delivery_events delivery
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           delivery.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE delivery.event_at >=
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              hours => scope_row.period_hours
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR message.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY delivery.event_type
),

handoff_statuses AS (
    SELECT
        handoff.status,
        COUNT(*) AS status_count
    FROM human_handoff_tasks handoff
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE handoff.created_at >=
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              hours => scope_row.period_hours
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR handoff.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY handoff.status
),

permission_decisions AS (
    SELECT
        permission.decision,
        COUNT(*) AS decision_count
    FROM communication_permission_checks permission
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE permission.checked_at >=
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              hours => scope_row.period_hours
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR permission.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY permission.decision
),

consent_statuses AS (
    SELECT
        consent.status,
        COUNT(*) AS status_count
    FROM patient_consents consent
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR consent.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY consent.status
),

clinical_intake_risks AS (
    SELECT
        intake.risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS risk_count
    FROM clinical_intake_cases intake
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE intake.created_at >=
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              hours => scope_row.period_hours
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR intake.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    GROUP BY intake.risk_level
),

latest_health AS (
    SELECT
        snapshot.id,
        snapshot.overall_status,
        snapshot.checks,
        snapshot.metrics,
        snapshot.checked_at
    FROM system_health_snapshots snapshot
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR snapshot.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    ORDER BY snapshot.checked_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

recent_errors AS (
    SELECT
        error_event.id,
        error_event.workflow_name,
        error_event.node_name,
        error_event.error_type,
        error_event.error_message,
        error_event.severity,
        error_event.status,
        error_event.retryable,
        error_event.occurrence_count,
        error_event.last_occurred_at
    FROM workflow_error_events error_event
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE error_event.status IN (
            'open',
            'acknowledged'
          )
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR error_event.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    ORDER BY
        CASE error_event.severity
            WHEN 'critical' THEN 1
            WHEN 'error' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END,
        error_event.last_occurred_at DESC
    LIMIT (
        SELECT detail_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
),

recent_dead_letters AS (
    SELECT
        dead_letter.id,
        dead_letter.outbound_message_id,
        message.channel,
        message.purpose,
        message.recipient,
        message.attempt_count,
        message.max_attempts,
        dead_letter.final_error_code,
        dead_letter.final_error_message,
        dead_letter.created_at
    FROM outbound_message_dead_letters dead_letter
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           dead_letter.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
    WHERE dead_letter.resolved = FALSE
      AND (
            scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
            OR message.clinic_id =
               scope_row.clinic_id
          )
    ORDER BY dead_letter.created_at DESC
    LIMIT (
        SELECT detail_limit
        FROM request_data
    )
),

summary_metrics AS (
    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'message_total',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM outbound_messages message
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE message.created_at >=
                      NOW() -
                      MAKE_INTERVAL(
                          hours =>
                            scope_row.period_hours
                      )
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR message.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            ),

        'message_backlog_due',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM outbound_messages message
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE message.status IN (
                        'queued',
                        'scheduled',
                        'failed'
                      )
                  AND message.next_attempt_at <= NOW()
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR message.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            ),

        'unresolved_dead_letters',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM outbound_message_dead_letters dead_letter
                INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
                    ON message.id =
                       dead_letter.outbound_message_id
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE dead_letter.resolved = FALSE
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR message.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            ),

        'open_handoffs',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM human_handoff_tasks handoff
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE handoff.status NOT IN (
                        'completed',
                        'resolved',
                        'cancelled',
                        'closed'
                      )
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR handoff.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            ),

        'open_workflow_errors',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM workflow_error_events error_event
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE error_event.status IN (
                        'open',
                        'acknowledged'
                      )
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR error_event.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            ),

        'clinical_intake_total',
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM clinical_intake_cases intake
                CROSS JOIN scope scope_row
                WHERE intake.created_at >=
                      NOW() -
                      MAKE_INTERVAL(
                          hours =>
                            scope_row.period_hours
                      )
                  AND (
                        scope_row.clinic_name IS NULL
                        OR intake.clinic_id =
                           scope_row.clinic_id
                      )
            )
    ) AS summary
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN scope_row.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND scope_row.clinic_id IS NULL
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN scope_row.clinic_name IS NOT NULL
         AND scope_row.clinic_id IS NULL
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'
        ELSE 'operational_dashboard_loaded'
    END AS result,

    scope_row.clinic_id,
    scope_row.clinic_name,
    scope_row.period_hours,

    (
        SELECT summary
        FROM summary_metrics
    ) AS summary,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                status,
                status_count
            )
            FROM message_statuses
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS message_statuses,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                event_type,
                event_count
            )
            FROM delivery_events
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS delivery_events,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                status,
                status_count
            )
            FROM handoff_statuses
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS handoff_statuses,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                decision,
                decision_count
            )
            FROM permission_decisions
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS permission_decisions,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                status,
                status_count
            )
            FROM consent_statuses
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS consent_statuses,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                risk_level,
                risk_count
            )
            FROM clinical_intake_risks
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS clinical_intake_risks,

    (
        SELECT TO_JSONB(health)
        FROM latest_health health
    ) AS latest_health,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(error_row)
            )
            FROM recent_errors error_row
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS recent_errors,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(dead_letter_row)
            )
            FROM recent_dead_letters dead_letter_row
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS unresolved_dead_letters,

    NOW() AS generated_at

FROM scope scope_row;

parameters.content:
## API خلاصه داشبورد

خروجی شامل:
- وضعیت صف پیام
- Delivery Eventها
- Handoffها
- تصمیم‌های Permission
- وضعیت رضایت‌ها
- ریسک Clinical Intake
- خطاهای باز
- Dead Letterهای باز
- آخرین Health Snapshot

اصلاح V2:
- clinic_name نامعتبر دیگر داده‌های همه کلینیک‌ها را برنمی‌گرداند.
- Summaryها صفر، Listها خالی و نتیجه clinic_not_found خواهد بود.
